data.desc: An interactive Windows 11 desktop experience built with React, Redux, and Vite. This portfolio project demonstrates window management, drag-and-resize interactions, a start menu, file explorer, terminal, and multiple integrated apps — all running in the browser as a progressive web app.

Multi-app desktop simulation
SCSS, Tailwind CSS, and i18n
